qab.help.select_db: /qab select db <file> - Select a QShop database exported by ChunkScanner (zip).
qab.help.select_list: /qab select list <file> - Select a shopping list (json).
qab.help.plan: /qab plan [name] - Generate a shopping plan from the selected db + list.
qab.help.nav_apply: /qab nav apply [file] - Auto-navigate and buy according to a plan.
qab.help.nav_stop: /qab nav stop - Stop the auto-buy run.
qab.help.stash_add: /qab stash add - Add the looked-at chest as a stash point.
qab.help.stash_list: /qab stash list - List all stash points.
qab.help.stash_remove: /qab stash remove <index> - Remove a stash point by its number (from 1).
qab.help.generate_list: /qab generate list <file> [config...] - Generate a shopping list from a schematic.
qab.help.region_open: /qab region open <name> - Open or create a region table.
qab.help.region_create: /qab region create <name> - Start the region selector (left/right click two corners).
qab.help.region_create_coords: /qab region create <name> <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> - Create a region by coordinates.
qab.help.region_visible: /qab region visible [on|off] - Toggle region highlight rendering.
qab.help.region_save: /qab region save - Persist the current region table.
qab.help.region_selector: /qab region selector [on|off] - Toggle the region selector.
qab.help.region_remove: /qab region remove <name> - Remove a region by name.
qab.help.region_list: /qab region list - List all regions in the current table.
qab.help.compound_save: /qab compound save [name] - Package the selected DB and current region table into a compound archive.
qab.help.compound_open: /qab compound open <name> - Open a compound archive and select its DB and region table.

text.autoconfig.qab_config.title: QShop Auto Buy - General (qab:config)
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.buyDel: Delay (ms) after arriving before sending the buy command (default 500).
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.buyCom: Command to run after arriving; {count} is replaced with the purchase amount.
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.clickR: Max distance at which the sign can be clicked (blocks, default 4.0).
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.sightB: Max ticks to wait when line of sight is blocked; treated as arrived after the timeout.
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.aimDeg: Max degrees per tick when turning to the sign (default 30); lower looks more human.
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.aimSet: Ticks to stand still after aiming precisely before clicking (default 2).
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.stashE: Stash inventory into a chest when space runs low, then continue buying.
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.stashP: Stash chest coordinates, format dimension(x,y,z); falls through to the next when full.
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.stashK: Item IDs to keep in the inventory while stashing (tools, currency, etc.).
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.stashR: Extra empty slots to reserve when predicting capacity (default 1).
text.autoconfig.qab_config.option.region: Enable the region selector (left/right click corners); also toggled by /qab region selector.
Render the region highlight box; also toggled by /qab region visible.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.title: QShop Auto Buy - Shopping List Generation (qab:schematic)
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.uno: Block IDs that cannot be bought (merged with the built-in default table).
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.irr: blockId -> itemId single mapping (merged with the built-in default table).
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.com: blockId -> [itemId, itemId] mapping (merged with the built-in default table).
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.nam: Shopping list name; defaults to the schematic file name.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.des: Shopping list description; auto-generated when empty.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.red: Extra amount to buy per item (default 0); overridable with redundancy= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.out: Output file name without extension; defaults to the list name.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.mul: Quantity multiplier (default 1.0); overridable with multiplier= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.min: Raise items below this count (default off); overridable with minCount= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.thr: Drop items below this count (default 1); overridable with threshold= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.inc: Count items stored inside container block entities; overridable with blockEntity= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.ded: Deduct items already in your inventory; overridable with deductInventory= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.raw: Keep raw block IDs (skip block->item mapping); overridable with rawId= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.exc: Block ID patterns to exclude (wildcards allowed); overridable with exclude= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.sor: count (by amount, default) / id (by ID); overridable with sort= on the command line.
text.autoconfig.qab_schematic.option.wat: Count 1 water bucket for each waterlogged (WATERLOGGED) block. Off by default (keeps current behavior).
